prompt:
Complete the Controller's four-project June WIP risk review at
`Shared/Finance/Close/2026/06 June/4 WIP/WIP risk cases_7.1 847am - NB REVIEW COPY.xlsx`.

Reconcile the June positions to the current accounting records and May close, resolve conflicts in the PM, commercial, and policy evidence, and quantify both the booked close case and material unbooked commercial exposure. Leave a formula-driven accounting tie and an unambiguous release or escalation decision for each project and for the portfolio.

Preserve the source/reference content and workbook style, recalculate, and save in place. Do not post or imply approval. A brief completion note is sufficient in the final response.
